dimensions.assessment: Affects Department of Veterans Affairs administrative personnel, financial officers, and certain veterans receiving pensions under specific payment limits.
dimensions.evidence: To amend title 38, United States Code, to clarify and expand the authority of the Assistant Secretary for Management of the Department of Veterans Affairs

dimensions.assessment: Modifies internal agency administrative structures, reporting lines, and staffing caps without altering baseline benefit eligibility for the broader veteran population.
dimensions.evidence: Not more than six full-time equivalent employees, including supervisors, may be assigned to the LCBI Office.

dimensions.assessment: The source does not detail significant new federal spending authorizations, focusing instead on internal restructuring and a date extension for pension limits.
Amends Title 38 internal structures by redesignating titles, increasing deputy assistant secretary positions, establishing a new congressional budget information office, and setting a 5-year sunset.
dimensions.evidence: On the day that is five years after the date of the enactment of the VA Fiscal Management Modernization Act, the following shall terminate

dimensions.assessment: Several internal management structures and offices feature a 5-year sunset, while the pension payment limitation is extended by eleven months through December 31, 2033.
dimensions.evidence: This section shall terminate on the day that is five years after the date of the enactment of the VA Fiscal Management Modernization Act.
